titleEn: Consciousness: a great gift or a costly price of evolution?
summaryEn:
To many people, the human brain is the pinnacle of evolution. It lets us create art, build civilisations, explore the stars and ask questions about our own existence.

But that ability comes with a deep paradox:

> Consciousness does not only bring intelligence. It also brings anxiety, fear and the weight of existence.

The very thing that makes humans special is also what means we can never live as lightly as most other creatures on Earth.
